references.text: The daily burnt offering (tamid) mentioned here is the same as referred to in Num 29:38 as 'the continual burnt offering'.
The sin offering goat is also mentioned earlier in the same chapter as part of the festival offerings.
Similar wording regarding the sin offering goat in addition to the continual burnt offering with its accompanying grain offering and drink offering.
The same pattern with a sin offering goat in addition to the daily offering is repeated for each day of the Feast of Tabernacles.
Repeated wording about the sin offering goat and the continual burnt offering with grain offering and drink offering.
Identical structure describing the sin offering and the daily offering.
Basic instructions regarding the sin offering (chattat) for unintentional sins.
Regulations concerning the sin offering goat (se'ir chattat) in Leviticus provide background for this offering.
The continual burnt offering (olat ha-tamid) was first instituted here as a daily offering at the entrance of the tabernacle.
